arguments.name: countryCode
arguments.description: The country code to search for (e.g., "000001"). Either countryCode OR countryName must be provided.

raw.name: countryCode
raw.description: The country code to search for (e.g., "000001"). Either countryCode OR countryName must be provided.

arguments.name: countryName
arguments.description: The country name to search for (e.g., "Philippines"). Either countryCode OR countryName must be provided.

raw.name: countryName
raw.description: The country name to search for (e.g., "Philippines"). Either countryCode OR countryName must be provided.

arguments.name: includeDetails
arguments.description: If true, fetches full details for each matching country (including isBase flag). If false or omitted, returns only basic info (faster). Default: false

raw.name: includeDetails
raw.description: If true, fetches full details for each matching country (including isBase flag). If false or omitted, returns only basic info (faster). Default: false

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description:
"search" (default) → requires countryCode or countryName
"showAll" → lists all countries page-by-page (can be unfiltered)

raw.name: mode
raw.description:
"search" (default) → requires countryCode or countryName
"showAll" → lists all countries page-by-page (can be unfiltered)

arguments.name: page
arguments.description: page number to return (default 1). Use page=2, page=3 … to get more.

raw.name: page
raw.description: page number to return (default 1). Use page=2, page=3 … to get more.
